worldcombat.skill.tickle.summary: Close in and tickle a foe into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defence at once. It must be used at contact range; a rough version drops more and lasts longer, but winds up and cools down much slower.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.use.1: Cut both Attack and Defence in a grapple
worldcombat.skill.tickle.use.2: Let an ally win the first exchange
worldcombat.skill.tickle.description.0: The tickled target loses %1$s Attack and %2$s Defence stage(s), and laughs for %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.description.1: Tickle reach %1$s over %2$s blocks; out of that you cannot reach them.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.description.2: Reaching in takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.firm: Off is a light tickle: fast, short cooldown, base Attack and Defence drops, a little less laughter; on pins the foe down and drops one more stage of each with longer laughter, but the windup and cooldown are clearly longer.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.ai.m: The companion only considers closing in while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it in a grapple, larger starts the chase sooner.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.ai.o: Countering reaches in only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime tickles any adjacent threat.
worldcombat.skill.tickle.preference.ai.l: When on, the companion may leave its post to tickle under a Hold order.
